notes: first isnad: Waki reports from Thabit; Thabit's question to Abu Jafar and Jabir's report are written inside it; Abu Jafar answers «نعم»; the chain stops at Jabir
second isnad («حدثنا بذلك هناد وقتيبة») comes after the matn and ends at Thabit; no extra link is added
«قال أبو عيسى» is the compiler's own voice and «ثابت بن أبي صفية هو أبو حمزة الثمالي» is an identification in the commentary; neither is used and the two names are not merged
